# Changelog

## v1.0

- Initial public release.
- Added animated random rock, paper, and scissors results.
- Added three hand-crafted 1-bit bitmap sprites.
- Added a custom 10x10 monochrome launcher icon.
- Added one-button replay with the OK button.
description:
# Rock Paper Scissors

Rock Paper Scissors is a minimal game for Flipper Zero. The app quickly cycles through three pixel-art hand signs and stops on a random result.

## Features

- Animated rock, paper, and scissors sequence
- A new random result on every play
- Large monochrome bitmap artwork
- Minimal one-button interface

## Controls

- OK: Play again
- BACK: Exit the application
